visual_logic.color_palette: Deep sea-foam green with silvery-white high-contrast underbelly markings, running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.action: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The elegant neck curve is stabilized parallel to the frame boundaries.
visual_logic.environment: Deep Cobalt water. The suspended marine snow, distant silhouetted squid, and white-clay cavitation bubbles are shifted entirely into the background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.

pose: The elasmosaurid plesiosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original curved gliding and active downward stroke pose is stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its head, hyper-elongated neck, streamlined torso, flippers (flattened toward the camera plane), and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
